dfm_alerts.description: Minimum wall draft is 1.00°: enough for a polished finish, short of the ~3° a textured finish ('VDI 24 matte texture, black') needs.
dfm_alerts.fix: Increase draft to 3° on textured faces, or specify a lighter texture / polished finish.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Draft ≥1° plus 1° per 0.025 mm texture depth — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; measured with text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Min wall draft vs pull +Z: lowest-draft B-rep wall face ≥ 19.61 mm² (flat, 51.95 mm² at [-42.79, 0.0, 0.85]) — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

dfm_alerts.description: Projected area along +Z: 4606 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 23.6 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
dfm_alerts.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 30 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Silhouette along +Z, raster 0.214 mm — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

dfm_alerts.description: Thin walls: 5% of the surface sits on walls ≤ 0.50 mm.
dfm_alerts.fix: Keep PC/ABS walls ≥ 1.2 mm; thicken local thin sections.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: 5th percentile of 3032 ray samples into the material (median 0.5 mm)

dfm_alerts.description: Ultrasonic welding of the shells puts heat and vibration next to a sealed lithium pouch cell; puncture or short-circuit risk.
dfm_alerts.fix: Keep the cell ≥3 mm from the weld line (validate with the cell supplier), add a cell pocket rib, and run a weld-energy test with a dummy cell.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: IEC 60086-4 (lithium battery safety) and cell supplier handling guideline — to be confirmed with supplier datasheet

dfm_alerts.description: Chip antenna detunes near metal (RFID-shield cards, metal wallets) and near the cell foil; range may drop in a real wallet.
dfm_alerts.fix: Keep a ground-free keep-out under the antenna, place it at the short edge away from the cell, tune matching in a wallet with typical cards.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Chip antenna vendor layout guideline (ground keep-out) — RF design practice

dfm_alerts.description: Stack tolerance of shells + PCB + cell + weld collapse can push total thickness above the wallet-slot limit.
dfm_alerts.fix: Specify 2.8 ± 0.15 mm after welding, define weld collapse (0.15 mm) and add a thickness check in QC.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Ultrasonic welding energy-director design guide (collapse 0.1-0.2 mm) — Branson/Emerson plastics joining handbook

dfm_alerts.description: Sealed shells attenuate the piezo buzzer; the card may be too quiet to find.
dfm_alerts.fix: Add a 1.5 mm sound port over the buzzer with acoustic mesh (BOM m4) and test SPL on the golden sample.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Piezo sounder acoustic-port practice — buzzer vendor application notes
